title: Personal Financial Management Program
summary: All levels of command Air, Ground, Logistics, and Installations with 75 or more assigned personnel. 7 items across the program.
applicabilityLevel: All levels of command Air, Ground, Logistics, and Installations with 75 or more assigned personnel

source.title: IGMC Functional Area Checklist - Personal Financial Management Program
source.publisher: Inspector General of the Marine Corps

subsections.title: UNIT-SPECIFIC PROGRAM (All Marine Corps units with more than 75 personnel)

items.question: Does the unit have the appropriate number of command appointed Command Financial Specialists (CFSs)?
Has the CFS completed the approved CFS course and the CFS refresher course every three years?
Have all Marines attended the Personal Readiness Seminar (PRS) within three months of arrival when the command is their first permanent duty station or Reserve Training Center?
Does the CFS complete the personal finance screening checklist prior to overseas/special duty assignments/independent duty orders for members of the command?
Can the CFS demonstrate that referrals are made to authorized providers of counseling and education?
Does the CFS update PFMP staff with overall financial trends or metrics in the commands?
Does the CFS make themselves readily available to speak at Welcome Aboard briefs, Command Team trainings, Transition events, and both pre-deployment and post-deployment briefings?
